name: Hindustan Hardy Limited
about: Hindustan Hardy Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, and sale of propeller shafts and other accessories in India and internationally. The company provides double cardan shafts for agricultural tractors, backhoe loaders, telescoping handlers, 4wd SUVs, all-terrain lift trucks, wheeled excavators, and cement mixers; propeller shafts, including universal joint and end fitment variants; universal joint kits; and flange yokes, slip yoke assemblies, agricultural yokes, steering joints and centre bearings, as well as stand-alone components and sub-assemblies. It serves automotive, agricultural, off-highway, industrial, and aftermarket sectors. The company was formerly known as Hindustan Hardy Spicer Limited and changed its name to Hindustan Hardy Limited in July 2018. The company was founded in 1961 and is based in Nashik, India. Hindustan Hardy Limited operates as a subsidiary of XLO India Private Limited.
